question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **youngest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Youngest" **refers to the person who is the least old among a group of people. (सबसे छोटा)

 
 
• **Example: **She is the youngest member of our family.
 
 
 
• **'Youngest'** grammatically appropriate as the sentence compares Ms. Meloni with all other Prime Ministers in the history of Italy, indicating she holds the topmost position in terms of youth among them.
 
• Using "youngest" highlights that she is younger than any previous Prime Minister, which aligns with the structure of the sentence comparing her unique attributes.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **youngest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Younger **(छोटा ): Comparative form of young, indicating less age than another person.

 
 
• **Example:** My younger brother is still in school.
 
 
 
• **Youthful **(युवा ): Having qualities associated with youth.
 
 
• **Example: **Her youthful appearance often makes people think she is younger than she is.
 
 
 
• **Young ** (युवा): Having lived or existed for only a short time.
 
 
• **Example:** He was very young when he started his first job.
